existing_features.title: Create a frontend dashboard displaying the current semen straw inventory with a table or card view showing straw details, filterable by availability status and searchable by bull ID
Build a frontend form to add new semen straw records with input fields for straw ID, bull identification, collection date, quality grade, storage location, and initial status
Implement frontend functionality to edit existing semen straw records and update their status (mark as sold, used, or available)
Apply a professional, agricultural-themed visual design with earthy tones (greens, browns, cream), clean typography, and a layout optimized for inventory management workflows
Update the add straw form in the frontend to include a quantity input field that accepts positive integers
Display the quantity column in the inventory table showing the current quantity for each semen straw record
Add the ability to edit quantity in the EditStrawForm component
Add a sell/sale functionality to record semen straw sales with fields for sale date, buyer information, quantity sold, and sale price
Display a sell/sale action button or option in the inventory table for each straw record to initiate the sale recording process
Update the AddStrawForm component to include an input field for straw color code
Update the EditStrawForm component to allow editing the straw color code
Display the color code column in the inventory table showing the color code for each semen straw record
Add a 'Generate Bill' or 'View Invoice' action button in the SalesHistory page for each sale record to display or download the sale bill
Create a frontend invoice/bill component that displays a formatted sale bill with a professional layout suitable for printing

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a backend data model to store semen straw inventory records with fields for: straw ID, bull identification, collection date, quality grade, storage location, and availability status
Implement backend functions to add new semen straw entries, update existing records, mark straws as sold or used, and retrieve inventory lists
Add sell/sale functionality to record semen straw sales
Add quantity tracking field to semen straw inventory records
Add a quantity field to the SemenStraw type in the backend data model to track the number of straws available for each record
Add a sell bill/invoice generation feature for semen straw sales
Add straw color code field to semen straw inventory records
Add a colorCode field to the SemenStraw type in the backend data model to store the color code of each semen straw
Add a backend function to generate a sale bill/invoice with sale details including sale ID, date, buyer information, straw details, quantity sold, and price
